title: Background music: longer pieces for each part of the day and the island
context: This is background music for the game. Today the game has four short loops of about 30 seconds each, and one of them (the calm train loop) plays almost everywhere: the title menu, the train and nearly every outdoor place and shop. That is the loop that repeats so often.
The seam you heard on the title menu is fixed in the game already (commit 8f9654b7): the loops no longer jump at the point where they start over. These new pieces are the second part of the job.

Here are 28 new instrumental pieces, four takes for each of seven uses: the title menu, the morning and work day outdoors, the evening, the night, inside the office, the shop street and the harbour. Each card name starts with its use (title-1 to title-4, morning-1 to morning-4, and so on), and its note says where it would play. Each piece plays for about two to two and a half minutes before it repeats, three to five times longer than today's loops.

All of them were asked for in one shared style: a soft acoustic ensemble for a cozy slice-of-life game, with piano, guitar, strings, light percussion and no vocals. Each use asks for its own mood and instruments on top of that. They were made locally with ACE-Step 1.5, a newer music model than the ones you judged in September, and each card is the piece as the game would loop it, set to the same loudness. A few have problems, and their notes say what they are.

Nothing here is in the game yet. Pick the take you like for each use, or reject all four for a use if none of them fit. Once you've picked, the chosen takes replace the old loops in those places and the uses you rejected get a new round. If the style as a whole is wrong, say so in the overall comment and the next round tries a different one.
